Asset tracking with RFID and BLE

The system knows where equipment, containers or garment bundles are, so less time goes on searching and less goes missing. An MVP in 6–10 weeks, from UZS 108 mln; the full version in 14–24 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

Timeline
MVP 6–10 weeksFull 14–24 weeks

Who it is for
Manufacturing, Textiles and garments, Clinics, Logistics, Construction
Integrations

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • RFID or BLE tags for one asset type
  • Readers at key points
  • Location and movement history
  • Stock-take in minutes
What the full version adds
  • Several zones and sites
  • Links to ERP or WMS
  • Alerts when assets leave a zone
  • Maintenance tracking
  • Reports

What we need from you

  • Site access and space for the devices
  • Internet or SIM cards
  • A budget for the hardware, which is not in the price

Questions

What does “Asset tracking with RFID and BLE” cost?
The MVP costs $9,000–18,000 (UZS 108–220 mln), the full version $25,000–60,000 (UZS 300–725 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Asset tracking with RFID and BLE” take?
The MVP takes 6–10 weeks, the full version 14–24 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
Site access and space for the devices; Internet or SIM cards; A budget for the hardware, which is not in the price.
